question:
Which of the following pairs of "term - definition" is correct?

I. Strait - a narrow strip of land joining two landmasses

II. Isthmus - a narrow passage of water connecting two large water bodies
solution:
The correct answer is __**Neither I nor II.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• A Strait__

 
 
• It is a landform connecting two large areas of water (seas).
 
• In other words, it is a water channel that lies between two land masses.
 
• It is also known to be loci for sediment accumulation.
 
• Usually, sand deposits on both sides of a strait form deltas.
